ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Alchemy & Artifacts
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Alchemy and artifacts for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
A spirit forge and an alchemy furnace that are upgraded in place (levels 1-3), spirit weapons with spirit grade (sword, sabre, spear, bow and flying sword), pills with quality and toxicity (foundation, tempering, blood purification, qi recovery), spirit herbs, a rune table that engraves ordinary weapons and a talisman table. No electricity needed.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation and Convergence: Resources.
